name: livepair
description: Search LivePair's prompt library — tested AI image and video prompts with the results they produced.

interface.longDescription: LivePair's prompt library — search prompts that are tested against real models, see the exact instruction and the output it produced, copy variations, and open any prompt in the LivePair studio to run it yourself. Search image and video prompts by style, subject, or model. Every prompt shows the result it actually generated, plus variants of the same base prompt with different outcomes.
capabilities: Search tested AI image & video prompts
See the output each prompt produced
